attributes.subtitle: The first ebook launch that pays readers to spread it.
attributes.project_overview_copy: Project Rebuild serves as the live proof-of-concept for FAMM, allowing indie creators to sell unlimited-mint NFT ebooks while rewarding readers with commissions and prize tickets. It launches on Base with "My Underdog Journey: To Own Goal," and supports the client's rebuilding mission, with a future vision of becoming the community-owned BooksOnChain platform.
attributes.technology_chainlink_vrf_copy: Random prize-draw selection that is provably fair.
attributes.technology_aave_integration_copy: Deposits allow the prize pools to generate yield.
attributes.technology_base_network_copy: Fast transactions and low fees, supported by Ethereum security.
attributes.technology_decentralization_copy: All logic is fully on-chain from day one, while V1 includes initial safeguards; battle-testing will guide the evolution to full decentralization.
attributes.technology_security_copy: Uses industry-leading protocols and best practices.
attributes.process_mint_copy: Buy the ebook NFT for $15 USD; the resulting mint number becomes the buyer's referral code.
attributes.process_referral_copy: Sharing a mint number or referral link earns an immediate $5 USD for each qualifying mint, with no limits or expiration. If no code is provided, the $5 and tickets are awarded to a random existing ticket holder.
attributes.process_ticket_copy: Every referral awards Small and Big Block prize tickets for the current blocks, with more tickets providing more chances.
attributes.process_prize_draw_copy: Small Block awards 5 × $500 every 500 sales, Big Block awards 5 × $10,000 every 50,000 sales, sales include mints and secondary sales, and Chainlink VRF selects winners randomly and fairly.
attributes.process_reward_delivery_copy: Commissions are delivered automatically on-chain. Prize wins are posted on the Winners page and can be claimed with one click.
attributes.feature_automatic_rewards_copy: Smart contracts issue all payments instantly.
attributes.feature_yield_generation_copy: Aave Integration enables the prize pools to accrue yield.
attributes.feature_gamification_copy: Badges and leaderboards keep the experience fun and competitive.
attributes.feature_transparency_copy: Every transaction and rule is on-chain and verifiable.
attributes.feature_low_fees_copy: Base provides speed with minimal transaction costs.
attributes.vision_copy: Project Rebuild begins with one book and envisions an ecosystem where ebooks succeed on merit, creators connect directly with readers, fans and affiliates are rewarded for word-of-mouth marketing, and aligned incentives support creators, communities, and the client's rebuilding mission.
